decisions.reason: The carpet is close to the core range and still has its own page in 2024. In a growing industry it plausibly meets aspirations, and slack lets the firm carry it.
The premium hand-knotted carpet fits the firm's craftsmanship positioning and is still prominently presented, so there is no shortfall that would trigger search for other uses.
The corner bench lost its own page in 2024, which signals weaker emphasis. It is still actively promoted, and its uncertain results can be carried with the firm's slack rather than cut.
This low-pile carpet keeps its own page, but a sibling carpet (C) was already pruned, so there is a modest risk of portfolio cleanup. Current evidence still suggests acceptable performance.
The swivel shell chair is close to the established seating offer and is consistently presented, so it likely meets aspirations with low cost to keep.
